_comment: Copy this file to tools/deploy.local.json and fill in your site.
deploy.local.json is gitignored, so your server details never leave your machine.
NEVER put the SSH key passphrase in this file. Use ssh.passphrase_env or
ssh.passphrase_from_scripts below, both of which keep it out of any file

_passphrase_note: Pick ONE of the two below, or omit both for an unencrypted key.
passphrase_env: name of an environment variable holding the passphrase.
passphrase_from_scripts: a folder of existing .py automation scripts to
scrape connection details from, so nothing new has to be written down.
If host or user are left empty above, they are scraped from there too.
